categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in property and casualty (P&C) insurance, life insurance, health insurance, and asset management. It conducts P&C insurance through PICC P&C and PICC Hong Kong, life and health insurance through PICC Life and PICC Health, and asset management through PICC AMC, PICC Investment Holding, PICC Capital, and PICC Pension. It also operates reinsurance business via PICC Reinsurance and technology services through PICC Technology.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced information technology including digital platforms, AI capabilities, data mining, and intelligent operation to enhance customer service and risk management. It has developed a unified multi-cloud and multi-core cloud platform, intelligent underwriting systems, and a risk prevention and control system. The company emphasizes technology empowerment at the grassroots level and digital transformation projects to improve operational efficiency and innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a broad customer base including individual policyholders, corporate clients, micro, small and medium enterprises, new citizens, rural households, and high-tech enterprises. It provides insurance products for motor vehicles, agriculture, health, liability, commercial property, and specialized sectors such as new energy vehicles and technology industries. The company also supports national strategies and social security systems, serving over 280 million rural households and millions of new citizens.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Mainland China, with significant presence in Hong Kong and Macau through its subsidiaries. Its international business network covers more than 80 countries and regions globally. Major operating regions within China include Guangdong, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Shandong, Hebei, Sichuan, Hubei, Hunan, Anhui, and Fujian provinces.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily downstream in the insurance value chain, providing insurance products and services directly to end customers. It also operates midstream asset management and reinsurance businesses, managing insurance assets and providing risk transfer solutions. The company acts as a financial intermediary and risk manager within the insurance and financial services ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include high-quality development, serving national strategies, innovation in insurance products (e.g., science and technology insurance, green insurance), digital transformation, and risk management enhancement. The company focuses on technology-driven innovation, AI integration, data governance, and building a world-class insurance financial group with strong governance and international competitiveness. It also emphasizes ESG and sustainable finance initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through insurance premiums from P&C, life, and health insurance products. Additional income comes from asset management fees, investment income, reinsurance services, and technology services. The company also earns underwriting profits and investment returns from its diversified portfolio of financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading large-scale integrated insurance financial group in China, holding the largest market share in the P&C insurance sector (31.8%) and a significant share in life and health insurance (3.8%). It is recognized as a pioneer and the first nationwide insurance company in China, with strong brand recognition and competitive advantages in scale, cost, service, and profitability. It faces competition from other major Chinese and international insurance firms but maintains a dominant industry position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024, the company reported total assets of RMB 1.77 trillion, insurance revenue of RMB 537.7 billion, and net profit of RMB 56.8 billion, with net profit attributable to owners at RMB 42.2 billion, reflecting strong growth (net profit up 84.3% year-on-year). The company has robust capital strength with a comprehensive solvency margin ratio of 281%. It has demonstrated steady growth in premiums, investment income, and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its long history as the first nationwide insurer in China, integrated insurance financial group structure, and strong alignment with national strategies. It offers diversified and innovative insurance products tailored to various customer segments, supported by advanced technology and data capabilities. Its value proposition includes comprehensive risk protection, strong asset management, professional health insurance services, and commitment to social responsibility and sustainable development.
